term: refers to (a name, in a practice's use)
definition: `N.RefersTo n b`: in the practice's use, the name n refers to (applies to) the being b. The practice-use sense of a name's application, as minimalists speak of reference inside a language game; not the proper sense fixed by a nominal definition (DEF-GOD-NOMINAL-Q13).
note: Typed reference relation for #1010 (owner request 2026-11-05). It fixes no theory of reference; DISAMB-NAME-APPLICATION says how it relates to the leaves' proper-sense predicate.
